oidcpro.config.section.General.label=General Configuration oidcpro.config.section.User.label=User Configuration oidcpro.config.section.Group.label=Group Configuration oidcpro.config.section.advanced=Advanced properties
oidcpro.config.property.skipped.label=Is enabled? oidcpro.config.property.skipped.hint=Defines whether this oidc client is enabled or not.
oidcpro.config.property.configurationName.label=Configuration name oidcpro.config.property.configurationName.hint=The name of this OIDC configuration oidcpro.config.property.clientId.label=Client ID oidcpro.config.property.clientId.hint=The client id retrieved from the OIDC provider you want to connect to. oidcpro.config.property.clientSecret.label=Client Secret oidcpro.config.property.clientSecret.hint=The client secret retrieved from the same OIDC Provider. The secret is usually displayed only once so make sure to copy it as soon as you get your hands on it. oidcpro.config.property.authorizationEndpoint.label=Authorization Endpoint oidcpro.config.property.authorizationEndpoint.hint=The endpoint of your provider where XWiki will try to authorize itself using the client id and secret you provided. oidcpro.config.property.tokenEndpoint.label=Token Endpoint oidcpro.config.property.tokenEndpoint.hint=The provider endpoint from where XWiki will retrieve the access and refresh tokens. oidcpro.config.property.userInfoEndpoint.label=User Info Endpoint oidcpro.config.property.userInfoEndpoint.hint=The provider endpoint where XWiki will retrieve the information of the user that wants to login. oidcpro.config.property.logoutEndpoint.label=Logout Endpoint oidcpro.config.property.logoutEndpoint.hint=If this property is filled, once the user logsout from XWiki, a logout request will also be sent to the OIDC provider, to the specified endpoint.

oidcpro.config.property.userNameFormatter.label=Username Formatter oidcpro.config.property.userNameFormatter.hint=The format that will be used in order to generate the xwiki username of a user coming from the OIDC provider. i.e. TODO:FILL oidcpro.config.property.userSubjectFormatter.label=User Subject Formatter oidcpro.config.property.userSubjectFormatter.hint=TODO:FILL oidcpro.config.property.userMapping.label=User Attribute Mapping oidcpro.config.property.userMapping.hint=This property maps the attributes of the user coming from the OIDC provider to XWiki user attributes. i.e. if the OIDC provider stores the user email in a property named 'electronic-mail', we want to let XWiki know this by filling this property like so: electronic-mail=email.
oidcpro.config.property.userInfoClaims.label=User Info Claims oidcpro.config.property.userInfoClaims.hint=TODO:FILL oidcpro.config.property.userInfoRefreshRate.label=User Info Refresh Rate oidcpro.config.property.userInfoRefreshRate.hint=TODO:FILL oidcpro.config.property.userInfoSkip.label=User Info Skip oidcpro.config.property.userInfoSkip.hint=If this property is set, then XWiki will skip the retrieval of the user information from the specialised endpoint. Useful for OAuth providers.
oidcpro.config.property.enableUser.label=Enable User oidcpro.config.property.enableUser.hint=TODO:FILL
oidcpro.config.property.groupsClaim.label=Group Claims oidcpro.config.property.groupsClaim.hint=TODO:FILL oidcpro.config.property.groupsMapping.label=Groups Mapping oidcpro.config.property.groupsMapping.hint=This property maps the groups coming from the OIDC provider to XWiki Groups. When a user coming from the OIDC provider logs in, they will also be added to the XWiki groups according to this mapping. i.e. OIDCGroupId=XWiki.AdminGroup
oidcpro.config.property.allowedGroups.label=Allowed Groups oidcpro.config.property.allowedGroups.hint=List all the OIDC groups that should be allowed to login into XWiki. OIDC users that belong to other groups will not be allowed to login. oidcpro.config.property.forbiddenGroups.label=Forbidden Groups oidcpro.config.property.forbiddenGroups.hint=List all the OIDC groups that should be denied entry to XWiki. Users belonging to these groups will not be allowed to login. i.e. OIDCGroup1,OIDCAdminGroup2 oidcpro.config.property.groupsMappingExclude.label=Groups Mapping Exclude oidcpro.config.property.groupsMappingExclude.hint=TODO:FILL
